ui.title: Free tools for everyday tasks
ui.intro: Calculate image dimensions, build CSS layouts and check image color modes. Choose a tool below.
ui.local: Runs in your browser. Files and inputs are not uploaded.
ui.englishNotice: The following links open pages in English.
ui.invalid: Enter valid positive dimensions. Bleed must be zero or greater.
ui.copyError: Copy failed. Select and copy the result manually.
ui.fileError: Unable to inspect this image. Try an original JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or GIF.
ui.colorNote: Header inspection does not validate print readiness, color accuracy or every embedded ICC profile. RGB is common for screens; ask your printer which profile to use for print.

aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.title: Aspect Ratio Padding Calculator
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.description: Calculate the CSS padding percentage for a responsive image, video or container from its width and height. Copy a modern aspect-ratio declaration or the padding fallback.
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.how: Enter the original width and height in the same unit. For 1920 × 1080, height divided by width times 100 gives 56.25%. The same ratio applies to 16 × 9.
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.limits: Padding percentages are based on the containing block’s width. The modern aspect-ratio property is usually simpler. This calculator does not resize images or add actual pixels.
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.question: Does this change the image dimensions?
aspect-ratio-padding-calculator.answer: No. It calculates CSS values only; the original image stays unchanged.

css-flexbox-generator.title: CSS Flexbox Generator
css-flexbox-generator.description: Build a CSS Flexbox layout with a live preview. Change direction, alignment, wrapping and spacing, then copy the generated container CSS.
css-flexbox-generator.how: Choose the main-axis direction, set justify-content and align-items, and adjust the gap. Increase the number of preview items to see how wrapping behaves. Paste the CSS into a stylesheet and apply the container class.
css-flexbox-generator.limits: The preview uses left-to-right CSS coordinates, even in the Arabic interface. Real content, item widths and parent styles affect wrapping. The tool generates container rules; it does not export an entire website.
css-flexbox-generator.question: Why do the option values remain in English?
css-flexbox-generator.answer: Values such as row and space-between are CSS keywords. Keep them unchanged when pasting the generated stylesheet.

rgb-cmyk-image-checker.title: RGB / CMYK Image Checker
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.description: Check whether an original JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or GIF image uses RGB, CMYK or another color mode by inspecting its file headers in your browser.
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.how: Choose a supported image. The tool reads up to the first 128 KiB and reports the detected file format, color mode, channels, transparency and presence of an ICC profile. Your image is not uploaded.
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.limits: Unusual, truncated or large metadata may prevent detection. An unknown result is not proof of RGB. The tool does not convert colors, inspect every pixel or certify a printer’s requirements.
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.question: Does a CMYK result guarantee correct printing?
rgb-cmyk-image-checker.answer: No. A printer may require a specific ICC profile, ink limit or PDF standard. Confirm the specifications before production.

image-megapixel-calculator.title: Megapixel Calculator
image-megapixel-calculator.description: Calculate the megapixel count and total pixel count of an image from its width and height in pixels. Compare camera and export dimensions without uploading a photo.
image-megapixel-calculator.how: Enter whole-pixel dimensions. Multiply width by height for the pixel count, then divide by 1,000,000 for megapixels. A 6000 × 4000 image contains 24,000,000 pixels, or 24 MP.
image-megapixel-calculator.limits: Megapixels describe resolution, not file size or visual quality. Compression, lens quality and lighting matter. The calculation does not change the image, estimate storage or determine a suitable print DPI.
image-megapixel-calculator.question: How many pixels are in one megapixel?
image-megapixel-calculator.answer: One megapixel is 1,000,000 pixels. The displayed result is rounded, while the calculation uses the entered dimensions.

print-bleed-calculator.title: Print Bleed Calculator
print-bleed-calculator.description: Calculate the document size needed for print bleed. Add an equal bleed allowance to every edge of a finished page, card or flyer.
print-bleed-calculator.how: Choose millimeters or inches, then enter the finished width, height and bleed per edge. A 210 × 297 mm page with 3 mm bleed becomes 216 × 303 mm. Changing units converts the current values.
print-bleed-calculator.limits: Confirm the required bleed with your printer. The calculator assumes equal bleed on all four sides. It does not add crop marks, set PDF page boxes or check that artwork extends into the bleed.
print-bleed-calculator.question: Is bleed the same as a safe area?
print-bleed-calculator.answer: No. Bleed extends beyond the trim edge. A safe area keeps text and important artwork inside the trim edge.
